verdict.rationale: Convertio is a browser-based, cloud file-conversion service with an API, CLI and wrappers. It is not an agent or AI assistant that would consume tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP-client or tool-consumption capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
